coverage_note: Amposta, Casablanca, Dorada, and Tarraco have accepted BOE regulator-record API values. Strict refreshes still fail closed until accepted cited factors cover every current CORES oil field.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the San Carlos I and II (Amposta) exploitation concessions, delivered at the destination port
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 122, Orden de 12 de mayo de 1976: San Carlos I and II (Amposta) crude sales price
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the San Carlos I and II (Amposta) exploitation concessions and states 17° API with 5.5% sulfur.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the Casablanca exploitation, stated at wellhead
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 167, Orden de 25 de mayo de 1977: Casablanca and Tarraco crude sales prices
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the Casablanca exploitation and states 33° API with 0.2% sulfur at the wellhead.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the Dorada exploitation concession, stated at field shipment position
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 151, Orden de 16 de junio de 1978: Dorada crude sales price
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the Dorada exploitation concession and states 21.3° API with 0.59% sulfur.

factors.measurement_basis: BOE national crude price order for crude from the Tarraco concession, stated at wellhead
factors.source_title: BOE Núm. 167, Orden de 25 de mayo de 1977: Casablanca and Tarraco crude sales prices
factors.evidence_note: The BOE order fixes the sales price for crude from the Tarraco concession and states 35° API with 0.2% sulfur at the wellhead.
